title: Display search field lists are per-resource and must match the decode keys
answers: How do I add/remove a field requested in IAM display search?
Why does service-account search request fewer fields than user search?
Adding a new searchable field to user or service-account display lookup
body:
Symptom: a field (e.g. email/login) is missing or wrongly populated for one identity type but not another in display search results.
Root cause: pkg/registry/apis/iam/display/search.go uses separate field-name slices per resource (userSearchDisplayFields vs serviceAccountSearchDisplayFields, service accounts omit USER_EMAIL/USER_LOGIN) wired into buildSearchJobs via the per-target `fields` entry.
Fix pattern: when adding a field, add its constant to the relevant resource's field slice AND add a corresponding extraction line in decodeDisplayRows/decodeDisplayTableRows (values[fieldConstant] or column index lookup) — the Fields sent in the request and the keys read out of DecodeSearchValues/table columns must stay in sync.
Constraints: field name constants come from resource.SEARCH_FIELD_* and builders.USER_EMAIL/USER_LOGIN; don't add a field to one resource's request list without a matching decode path, or it will be silently ignored.

When adding a field, add its constant to the relevant resource's field slice AND add a matching extraction line in decodeDisplayRows/decodeDisplayTableRows so the Fields in the request and the keys read from DecodeSearchValues/table columns stay in sync. Field name constants come from resource.SEARCH_FIELD_* and builders.USER_EMAIL/USER_LOGIN; a field missing from either the request list or decode path will be silently ignored. Applies to tasks modifying pkg/registry/apis/iam/display/search.go (buildSearchJobs, decodeDisplayRows).
